lines: He that composition made great meaning; by reason āgama spoken tantra principle; having attained light whose this world; happily moves in actions.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sa tannibandhaṃ vidadhe mahārthaṃ yuktyāgamodīritatantratattvam ālokamāsādya yadīyameṣa lokaḥ sukhaṃ saṃcaritā kriyāsu
